business_problem: Founded in 2016 by Eric Seyoung Jang, DeepBrain AI has been on a mission to design AI that helps people be the most creative and meaningful versions of themselves. Based out of Palo Alto, California, DeepBrain AI supports customers around the globe with its groundbreaking AI solutions across several industries, including finance, commerce, retail, education, and media. Now, with the power of Azure AI solutions and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), DeepBrain AI can supercharge its offerings to bring its customers exciting new capabilities.
